title: Salvianolic Acid A Protects Against Angiotensin II-Induced Hypertensive Kidney Disease by Targeting TLR4 and Inhibiting TLR4/Myd88/PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB Pathway.
authors: Wang, Wenhan; Zhang, Ji; Zhou, Jianghua; Cao, Zhenyang; Zheng, Qianrong; Huang, Pan; Huang, Peipei; Qian, Jinfu; Ding, Xiaokai; Chen, Chaosheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药单体SAA通过靶向TLR4抑制炎症通路治疗高血压肾病，虽含分子对接但核心为药物-蛋白作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hypertensive nephropathy (HN), a significant consequence of chronic hypertension, remains a leading contributor to end-stage renal disease. Excessive Angiotensin II (Ang II)-driven inflammation, apoptosis, and fibrosis are central to its pathogenesis. Salvianolic acid A (SAA), a polyphenolic compound from Salvia miltiorrhiza, has anti-inflammatory properties, but its therapeutic potential in HN is unclear. HN was induced in mice by continuous subcutaneous infusion of Ang II (1.44 mg/kg/day) for 28 days. SAA (10 or 20 mg/kg/day) was administered orally every day during the final 14 days. Network pharmacology suggested SAA targets the TLR4/PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB pathway. SAA administration improved renal function and attenuated inflammatory infiltration, tubular cell apoptosis, and interstitial fibrosis, independent of systemic blood pressure. NRK-52E cells were used in vitro. SAA inhibited PI3K and AKT phosphorylation, suppressed NF-kappaB P65 activation, and downregulated pro-inflammatory cytokines. The PI3K activator 740 Y-P abolished these effects. Pull-down, DARTS assays and molecular docking showed interaction between SAA and TLR4, while TLR4 overexpression reversed SAA's protective actions. These findings provide the evidence that SAA exerts protective effects against Ang II-induced HN, acting through inhibition of the TLR4/MyD88/PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB axis and represents a potential TLR4-targeted therapy for hypertensive kidney injury.
abstract_zh: 高血压肾病（HN）是慢性高血压的重要后果，仍是终末期肾病的主要诱因。过量的血管紧张素II（Ang II）驱动的炎症、凋亡和纤维化是其发病机制的核心。丹酚酸A（SAA）是丹参中的一种多酚类化合物，具有抗炎特性，但其在HN中的治疗潜力尚不明确。通过持续皮下输注Ang II（1.44 mg/kg/天）28天诱导小鼠HN。在最后14天期间，每天口服给予SAA（10或20 mg/kg/天）。网络药理学提示SAA靶向TLR4/PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB通路。SAA给药改善了肾功能，减轻了炎症浸润、肾小管细胞凋亡和间质纤维化，且不依赖于全身血压。体外使用NRK-52E细胞。SAA抑制了PI3K和AKT磷酸化，抑制了NF-kappaB P65激活，并下调了促炎细胞因子。PI3K激活剂740 Y-P消除了这些效应。Pull-down、DARTS实验和分子对接显示SAA与TLR4之间存在相互作用，而TLR4过表达逆转了SAA的保护作用。这些发现提供了证据，表明SAA通过抑制TLR4/MyD88/PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB轴对Ang II诱导的HN发挥保护作用，并代表了一种针对高血压肾损伤的潜在TLR4靶向治疗策略。
